meta.project: AICyberAuditBox - Audit Checkpointing, Stop/Resume & Knowledge Loop Sync

product_overview: AICyberAuditBox is an AI-assisted audit platform for ISO 27001 compliance and VAPT analysis, using RAG-based document retrieval and finding generation. This PRD also covers robust checkpointing, stop/resume lifecycle control, and secure feedback knowledge-loop synchronization.
core_goals: Evaluate uploaded policy and evidence documents against ISO 27001:2022 Annex A controls with reliable finding generation.
Ingest vulnerability scan logs and generate technical VAPT findings with POC extraction, CVSS scoring, and control mapping.
Persist granular audit checkpoints after each control to support fault-tolerant execution and exact resume behavior.
Allow audit sessions to be stopped, unblocked, and safely resumed without re-running already completed controls.
Export and import auditor feedback securely, including validation, duplicate prevention, and PII redaction for future RAG calibration.

features.name: ISO 27001 RAG Flow
features.description: Evaluates uploaded ISMS policy documents and evidence against ISO 27001 controls using hybrid semantic retrieval and finding generation.
user_flows: POST /api/audit/upload with ISO policy/evidence documents -> Receive 200 confirmation for uploaded audit content -> POST /api/audit/start with a valid session payload -> Receive 200 with ISO 27001 audit findings generated from retrieved policy and evidence

POST /api/audit/upload with malformed or unsupported document data -> Receive 400 or 415 error indicating upload validation failure -> POST /api/audit/start without usable evidence -> Receive 400 Bad Request due to insufficient audit input or zero-evidence guard

features.name: VAPT Technical RAG Flow
features.description: Processes vulnerability assessment and penetration testing logs to extract POC evidence, score severity, and map technical issues to VAPT controls.
user_flows: POST /api/audit/upload with VAPT scan logs and technical evidence -> Receive 200 confirmation for ingested vulnerability data -> POST /api/audit/start with the uploaded session context -> Receive 200 with VAPT findings, CVSS scoring, and control mappings

POST /api/audit/upload with corrupted logs or malicious file content -> Receive 400 or 415 error from ingestion validation -> POST /api/audit/start with no valid technical evidence -> Receive 400 Bad Request indicating the analysis cannot proceed

features.name: Granular Audit Checkpointing
features.description: Persists audit progress after every control evaluation so long-running audits can be tracked and resumed safely.
user_flows: POST /api/audit/start with a multi-control audit session -> Receive 200 with an active session_id -> GET /api/audit/status/{session_id} -> Receive 200 with completed_batches, total_controls, and active status metadata

POST /api/audit/start with a large control set -> Receive 200 with session_id -> GET /api/audit/status/{session_id} for a partially completed run -> Receive 200 showing checkpoint progress after each evaluated control
GET /api/audit/status/{session_id} with an unknown or unauthorized session_id -> Receive 404 Not Found or 403 Forbidden instead of checkpoint metadata

features.name: Audit Stop & Unblock Lifecycle
features.description: Stops active background audit execution, releases leased model slots, and unblocks the session so it can be managed or resumed later.
user_flows: POST /api/audit/stop/{session_id} for an active audit -> Receive 200 confirming stop request accepted -> GET /api/audit/status/{session_id} -> Receive 200 showing stopped or unblocked session state
POST /api/audit/stop/{session_id} for a session owned by another tenant -> Receive 403 Forbidden -> GET /api/audit/status/{session_id} -> Receive 403 or no access to the protected session metadata

features.name: Resume Audit from Exact Checkpoint
features.description: Restores the latest saved checkpoint, reloads completed findings, and resumes processing only the remaining controls.
user_flows: POST /api/audit/resume-checkpoint with a valid session_id -> Receive 200 indicating latest AuditCheckpoint was loaded -> GET /api/audit/status/{session_id} -> Receive 200 showing resumed execution from the saved progress point

POST /api/audit/resume-checkpoint for a session with no checkpoint data -> Receive 404 Not Found or 400 Bad Request -> GET /api/audit/status/{session_id} -> Receive 200 or error state indicating nothing was resumed
POST /api/audit/resume-checkpoint with an invalid or unauthorized session_id -> Receive 403 Forbidden or 404 Not Found

features.name: Knowledge Loop Feedback Export
features.description: Exports validated auditor corrections and calibration examples in JSON for offline review or transfer.
user_flows: GET /api/audit/feedback/export for a permitted user -> Receive 200 with valid JSON containing AuditorFeedback records and few-shot calibration examples
GET /api/audit/feedback/export with no authorization token -> Receive 401 Unauthorized and no feedback data returned
GET /api/audit/feedback/export for a tenant without records -> Receive 200 with an empty JSON array or empty export payload

features.name: Knowledge Loop Feedback Import & PII Redaction
features.description: Imports feedback JSON, validates records, redacts sensitive data, prevents duplicates, and injects safe examples into future RAG context.
user_flows: POST /api/audit/feedback/import with a valid JSON feedback file -> Receive 200 confirming import success -> GET /api/audit/feedback/export -> Receive 200 showing normalized records with emails, IPs, and phone numbers redacted

POST /api/audit/feedback/import with duplicate feedback entries -> Receive 409 Conflict or 200 with duplicate records skipped -> GET /api/audit/feedback/export -> Receive 200 showing only unique imported records
POST /api/audit/feedback/import with invalid JSON or unsupported file format -> Receive 400 Bad Request indicating validation failure

POST /api/audit/feedback/import with feedback containing PII such as emails, IPs, or phone numbers -> Receive 200 with redaction applied before storage -> Subsequent audit RAG prompt context uses sanitized examples

features.name: ISO 27001 RAG Flow
features.description: Dual Policy and Evidence semantic retrieval, hybrid keyword-vector scoring, and ISO finding generation.

features.name: VAPT Technical RAG Flow
features.description: Technical vulnerability log ingestion, POC snippet extraction, CVSS severity scoring, and VAPT control mapping.
